How it works

1Pick & upload

Choose one of our 9 stocked cap styles and upload your logo — any common file format works.

2Approve your proof

Within 2–3 business days we email a digital sew-out proof. Nothing stitches until you approve it.

3We embroider

Your logo is stitched on the exact caps and colors you picked, in our Milton WA shop.

4Ships free

Your caps ship 7–10 business days after proof approval — free shipping, always.

Questions, answered

When exactly will my caps ship?

We email your digital proof within 2–3 business days of your order. Once you approve it, your caps ship 7–10 business days later. Weekends and holidays don’t count as business days — and nothing stitches until you’ve approved the proof.

What’s included in the price?

Everything on the front: the cap itself, logo setup and digitizing (free, always), and an embroidered front logo up to 10,000 stitches — which covers nearly every logo. A back logo is an optional per-cap add-on, priced live as you build your order.

Why is there an 8-cap minimum?

Embroidery setup makes one-off caps expensive — 8 caps is where the price gets fair. The price ladder shows exactly how the per-cap price drops at 24, 48, and 72 caps.

What file should I upload?

Anything common: PNG, JPG, SVG, AI, EPS, PDF, PSD, or TIFF up to 20 MB. Our digitizers convert it to stitches by hand and your emailed proof shows exactly how it will sew before we start.

Can I mix cap colors?

Yes — pick as many colors of the same style as you like. The combined quantity sets your price tier, so 12 black + 12 navy caps all get the 24-cap price.

How much is shipping?

Free. Every order ships free anywhere in the US, or pick up free at our shop in Milton, WA.

Can I return custom caps?

Because every cap is embroidered just for you, we can’t resell returns. If we got something wrong — wrong color shipped, stitching defect — we’ll re-stitch or refund, no drama.

Do you charge sales tax?

Washington destination sales tax applies to orders shipped within WA (and pickup orders at the Milton rate). Out-of-state shipments aren’t taxed.

Nothing stitches until you approve the proof.

    How it works

    1Pick & upload

    Choose one of our 20 print-tested styles, then drop your artwork into the live designer.

    2Approve the preview

    What you see on the shirt is the approval record our printers work from.

    3We print

    Full-color DTG on the exact garment and color you picked, in our Milton WA shop.

    4Ships in 7–10 days

    Standard orders ship in 7–10 business days. Need it faster? 3-Day Rush is available on select styles.

    Questions, answered

    When exactly will my order ship?

    Standard orders ship in 7–10 business days. Select styles offer a 3-Day Rush upgrade — orders placed before 9 AM Pacific on a business day ship 3 business days later, and the exact date is shown on the Pay button before you’re charged. Weekends and holidays don’t count as business days.

    What if my artwork is low resolution?

    The designer measures your file’s print resolution live. If it’s too low to print crisply we’ll flag it before checkout — you can shrink it, swap the file, or accept how it will look.

    Can I upload AI / EPS / PDF files?

    Yes. Browsers can’t preview those formats, so you’ll position a sized box where you want the art, and our team will match it and email you a proof before printing — usually within 2 business hours. Your production clock starts at proof approval.

    How are small orders priced?

    Orders under 24 pieces are priced at our small-batch per-shirt rate — built into the price you see, no extra fees. Volume pricing kicks in at 24+ pieces, and the designer shows you exactly how close you are.

    How much is shipping?

    FREE UPS Ground shipping on orders $100+ ($7.99 flat under $100). Free pickup in Milton, WA.

    Can I return custom-printed shirts?

    Because every order is printed just for you, we can’t resell returns. If we got something wrong — wrong size shipped, print defect — we’ll reprint or refund, no drama.

    Do you charge sales tax?

    Washington destination sales tax applies to orders shipped within WA. For pickup orders, sales tax is calculated for our Milton, WA location. Out-of-state shipments aren’t taxed.

    If we miss the ship date, shipping’s on us.

    We’ve been printing in Milton, Washington since 1977. Call us at 253-922-5793 — a human answers.
